_comment: Copy this file to data/topic-graph.json to reshape the concept map for your course.
Keys and prerequisite entries are topic slugs: the lower-cased Topic enum name,
which is also the directory name under data/questions/.
An override REPLACES that topic's built-in prerequisite list everywhere:
unlocking, the auto feed, and the map. Unknown slugs are warned about and ignored;
a set of overrides that would create a cycle is rejected wholesale.
